children: SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (KRX:000660) is riding AI-driven memory strength—stock and ADR gains and a $4B+ Indiana HBM/R&D investment with U.S. aid and 7,000 jobs—while CEO warns extended tightness to 2030 even as funds cut positions and unions narrowly reject a pay deal.
SK hynix ADR Surge Drives EM AI Gains
: SK hynix ADR (000660) surged ~456% year-over-year, driving EM AI gains. Intraday, the ADR rose about 2.5%, lifting Korea's KOSPI and peers in the memory-chip sector.
SK hynix to Invest $4B+ Indiana HBM Site
: SK hynix (000660) will invest $4B+ to build a 133.5-acre Indiana HBM packaging and AI semiconductor R&D site. Cleanrooms due H2 2028; project ~7,000 jobs. U.S. aid ~ $958M.
: SK hynix (000660): CEO Kwak says global memory shortage may last through 2030, low oversupply risk, no current oversupply signs, AI demand keeps memory premium; future downturn likely gradual.
EPFR: SK hynix ADR Outflows Record
: Funds tied to SK hynix Inc. Sponsored ADR (000660) saw record net outflows in the latest EPFR report, signaling large investor reductions in SK hynix positions.
: Bank of America reaffirmed Buy on SK hynix (000660) and kept a $250 target, citing expected long-term memory supply tightness that supports industry pricing and demand.
SK hynix ADR Wage Deal Rejected
: SK hynix ADR (000660): union narrowly rejected tentative wage and bonus deal by 50.08% (25-vote margin). Offer: 6.3% pay bump, profit-linked bonuses split 40% cash/60% shares.
: Q1 NAND market share: Samsung 29%, SK hynix (000660) 18%, YMTC ~13% — SK hynix ranks second in NAND share, trailing Samsung and ahead of YMTC and Micron.
